scripts.lint: bun run boundary:check && vp lint --fix packages/*/src boundary.config.ts
scripts.lint:check: bun run boundary:check && vp lint packages/*/src boundary.config.ts
scripts.check:exact-versions: bun -e 'const p=JSON.parse(await Bun.file("package.json").text()); const d=Object.entries({...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies}); const bad=d.filter(([,v])=>!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/.test(v)); if(bad.length){console.error("Non-exact dependency versions:",bad.map(([n,v])=>n+"@"+v).join(", ")); process.exit(1)}'
scripts.ready: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run audit && bun run outdated && bun run check:exact-versions && bun run build
